sources.title: Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct model card
sources.evidence: Exact official Instruct repository. Its model information identifies Meta, nominal 70B size, text input/output, multilingual dialogue, July 23, 2024 release, downloadable checkpoints and Llama 3.1 license. Tool-use section documents structured calls. Reopened October 27: model information explicitly covers pretrained and instruction-tuned 70B models and describes SFT/RLHF post-training.

sources.title: The Llama 3 Herd of Models, v3
sources.evidence: Table 1 explicitly separates Llama 3 70B Instruct (April, no tools) from Llama 3.1 70B Instruct (July, tools). It states subsequent results concern 3.1. Section 3.2 and Table 3 establish dense Transformer architecture, GQA, and the 70B configuration.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 Community License Agreement
sources.evidence: Original version-specific license for Llama 3.1 materials, including trained weights. Names the July 23, 2024 version release and grants conditional use, reproduction, redistribution and modification rights.

sources.title: Meta model identifiers, families and maximum sequence length
sources.evidence: Maps the exact llama3_1_70b_instruct identifier to the llama3_1 family; max_seq_length returns 131072 for that family.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 evaluation details
sources.evidence: Explicitly covers 3.1 8B, 70B and 405B, including post-trained models. Long-context evaluation subtracts generated tokens from 131072 and distinguishes other models using 128000. Documents prompted chain-of-thought evaluation.

sources.title: Llama 3.1 prompt formats
sources.evidence: Documents Instruct chat, built-in tools and custom function calls. Native protocol uses python_tag, eom_id and the ipython tool-result role. The listed roles/tokens and examples do not disclose a dedicated reasoning mode or thinking switch.

sources.title: Meta Llama 3.1 Instruct model configurations
sources.evidence: Exact 70B Instruct entry links its Hugging Face repository and specifies 80 layers, dimension 8192, 64 attention heads, 8 KV heads, and scaled RoPE. Fresh comparison confirms the base and Instruct 70B entries use identical arch_args, including vocabulary and FFN settings, supporting unchanged structure through instruction tuning.

sources.title: Exact checkpoint configuration access attempt
sources.evidence: Public request returned HTTP 401. No gated access was bypassed and no weights were downloaded; this attempted source supports no technical claim.

sources.title: Zipf’s and Heaps’ Laws for Tokens and LLM-generated Texts, Table 3
sources.publisher: Nikolay Mikhaylovskiy, NTR Labs / Tomsk State University; EMNLP Findings 2025
sources.evidence: Original empirical research lists Llama-3.1-70B at 70B total and 70B active parameters in Table 3 (PDF page 4). Section 4.1 uses base and original instruction-tuned models with NF4 quantization. Figures 10 and 13 show only smaller Instruct Llamas, so this is direct evidence for the named base model; applying its nominal active-count convention to 70B Instruct requires Meta’s documented lineage and matching architecture. The count is the researcher’s convention, not a Meta active-count disclosure.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V3 Technical Report, original comparison tables
sources.evidence: Fresh full-text search found no 70B comparison for the exact Llama 3.1 Instruct model. Its 405B comparisons do not establish this model’s active count.

sources.title: Qwen2.5 Technical Report, instruction-model comparisons
sources.evidence: Table 6 and Section 5.2 identify Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct as a comparison model, but the inspected tables do not give it a separately labeled active-parameter count.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report, activated-parameter comparisons
sources.evidence: The inspected activated-parameter tables include other Llama releases and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, not an exact Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct row. Those distinct models do not directly establish this count.

name.note: Exact official repository name; distinguishes Instruct from the base checkpoint.

family.note: Catalog family normalization; exact release belongs to Llama 3.1 within Llama.

release_date.note: Explicit model release date, corroborated by the version-specific license; day precision retained.

open_weights.note: Official checkpoint distribution and redistribution license establish open weights, subject to license/access terms; not an open-source classification.

license.note: Exact original 3.1 license, rather than the original Llama 3 or a later version license.

parameters_b.note: Freshly confirmed Meta-published nominal total of 70 billion parameters for the exact Instruct release. Retains the developer’s stated precision without requiring a tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Labeled lineage inference: Mikhaylovskiy’s Table 3 reports 70B active for Llama-3.1-70B. Meta identifies its Instruct counterpart as an SFT/RLHF-tuned model and publishes identical base/Instruct architecture settings, with no structural change indicated. Apply that researcher’s nominal convention to Instruct; this is neither a separate Meta disclosure nor an exact per-token census.

architecture.note: Autoregressive dense Transformer with GQA: exact Instruct configuration has 80 layers, hidden width 8192, 64 query heads and 8 KV heads. No mixture-of-experts routing.

context_window.note: 128K means 131072 tokens here. Meta explicitly budgets input plus generated tokens against this limit; baseline 128000 is corrected.

modalities.note: Released 70B Instruct is text-only; generated code is text, not a separate modality.

reasoning.note: No dedicated reasoning mode is disclosed in inspected official prompt and evaluation documentation. Ordinary CoT ability and tool-continuation tags do not establish one; baseline false is cleared.

tool_call.note: Table 1 specifically marks 3.1 70B Instruct as tool-capable. Native protocol includes structured calls and tool-result continuation; the executor performs the tool action.

description.value: Open-weight 70B dense Transformer instruction model for multilingual text dialogue and tool calling.
description.note: Clarifies weight availability and supported release-specific capabilities without implying a dedicated reasoning mode.

patch.description: Open-weight 70B dense Transformer instruction model for multilingual text dialogue and tool calling.

sources.label: Meta 3.1 native prompt and tool protocol

patch.notes: 70B total is Meta’s nominal specification. Nominal 70B active is inferred from Mikhaylovskiy’s base-model convention through Meta’s documented Instruct lineage and matching architecture, not a separate Meta active-count disclosure. Native context is 131072 tokens including generation. Dedicated reasoning mode is undisclosed; this does not deny ordinary reasoning ability.

summary: Fresh parameter re-audit retains Meta’s nominal 70B total and establishes nominal 70B active by an explicitly labeled lineage inference from Mikhaylovskiy’s Table 3 and Meta’s matching base/Instruct configurations. DeepSeek-V3 and Qwen2.5/3 comparisons supplied no more direct active-count evidence for this exact Instruct model. Exact per-token participation remains unspecified. The other twelve assessments are preserved, including the original 3.1 license, 131072-token context, native tools and undisclosed dedicated reasoning mode. No weights downloaded.
